findings.statement: CT-104 for Pon Logistics: 3 closed container bodies, ₹15,30,000, contracted 10 Sep 2026, expected by 31 Oct 2026; status in_production. Jobs: J-104A (painting), J-104B (fabrication), J-104C (fabrication).
PUR-2056 is struck out in the book (void); it is not counted.
EX-401 (Freight for square tube from Coimbatore, ₹6,000) is shared: ₹4,000 is charged to CT-104 and the rest to CT-105. Only ₹4,000 counts here.
PUR-2047 (MS square tube 40x40 (120 length), ₹1,38,000) is shared: ₹92,000 is charged to J-104B, J-104C and the rest to J-105A. Only ₹92,000 counts here.
Recorded direct cost so far: ₹8,51,700 from 27 book entries (35 charges, as some are split across bodies): materials ₹7,59,900, labour ₹71,500, machinery ₹11,800, other direct ₹8,500.
PUR-2053 (PU enamel paint 20L (3 drum), ₹28,500) is noted for CT-104, CT-105 with no split recorded. ₹28,500 is not counted in any contract's cost until the split is decided.
WG-413 (Helper, 6 days (2026-10-05 to 2026-10-10), ₹3,600) is noted for CT-104, CT-105 with no split recorded. ₹3,600 is not counted in any contract's cost until the split is decided.
WG-416: Murugan, Welding, 4 days (2026-10-12 to 2026-10-15), ₹3,600 has no job recorded. It may belong to this or another contract; it is not counted anywhere.

₹39,790 of workshop costs are not charged to any contract (EX-402 ₹3,850, EX-404 ₹18,400, MC-403 ₹11,040, MC-404 ₹6,500). They are excluded from every contract's direct cost; decide whether and how to share them.

Provisional profit based on recorded direct costs: ₹6,78,300 (44.3% of ₹15,30,000). If all ₹32,100 of unsplit costs noted for it were charged here, it would be ₹6,46,200. Not final profit: overheads, unassigned labour and future costs are not included.
Pon Logistics has paid ₹8,00,000 against CT-104 in 2 cleared receipt(s); ₹7,30,000 of the contract value is still to be received. Receipts are cash collected, not additional revenue.
PUR-2055 (Lakshmi Welding Stores, ₹31,000): payment SP-307 of ₹31,000 is recorded but not cleared, so the bill is not yet confirmed as paid.
PUR-2058 (Sri Balaji Steels, ₹58,000): the purchase book says 'paid', but the supplier payment book shows ₹0 cleared against it (payments: none).

Supplier bills on this contract with money still owed per payment records: MC-401 Arun Crane & Equipment Hire ₹7,000 of ₹7,000; PUR-2042 Sri Balaji Steels ₹67,400 of ₹1,67,400; PUR-2047 Coimbatore Steel Traders ₹1,38,000 of ₹1,38,000 (whole bill, shared with J-105A); PUR-2055 Lakshmi Welding Stores ₹31,000 of ₹31,000; PUR-2058 Sri Balaji Steels ₹58,000 of ₹58,000. These are amounts owed, not extra cost.

SP-309: ₹25,000 paid to Sri Balaji Steels on 14 Oct 2026 is not applied to any bill. Open bills from this supplier on this contract: PUR-2042 (₹67,400 unpaid), PUR-2058 (₹58,000 unpaid). Which bill it settles is not recorded.
WG-417 (Selvam, ₹3,400): the wage book does not say whether it was paid. It is counted as cost; whether it is still owed is unknown.
Wages charged to this contract and recorded as unpaid: WG-414 Ilango ₹3,400; WG-415 Ravi ₹3,200. They are already in cost; paying them adds no cost.

decisions_required: Decide how much of PUR-2053 (₹28,500) belongs to CT-104 versus CT-105.
Decide how much of WG-413 (₹3,600) belongs to CT-104 versus CT-105.
Record which job WG-416 (Murugan) worked on.
Decide a rule for sharing workshop overheads across contracts.
Reconcile PUR-2058 with the supplier payment book.
missing_information: No source record supports MC-404 (Plasma cutter: maintenance (1 service)).
warnings: CT-104 is still in_production: costs still to come are not in the records, so profit will change.

Figures are provisional and based only on the recorded entries. They are not statutory accounts: no GST, depreciation, inventory valuation or overhead absorption is applied. Confirm with the accountant before relying on them.
calculation_rules: Recorded direct cost = sum of the amounts charged (CHARGED_TO) to this contract or its jobs from valid purchase, labour, machinery and expense entries.
A shared bill counts only for the portion charged here; the rest belongs to the other jobs or contracts it is charged to.
Charges recorded without an amount are excluded and reported as unknown, not as zero.
Costs only noted for this contract, without an amount, are excluded until someone decides the split.
Workshop overheads not charged to any contract are excluded.
Provisional profit = contract value - recorded direct cost. It is not final or statutory profit: no tax, depreciation, inventory valuation or overhead absorption is applied.
Supplier payments and customer receipts settle amounts owed; they never add cost or revenue. Only cleared payments count as paid.
